name: Newmont Corporation
research_rationale: Refreshed Q3 earnings and TTM free cash flow support the screen, but the mid-November gold-led share sell-off and mixed valuation commentary partly offset the strong-buy signal.

weekly_updates.summary:
Refreshed quarterly data show solid Q3 earnings, ~$10.1bn TTM free cash flow and continued buybacks; press pieces cite record profit and lower costs at key Australian assets.
Duquesne Family Office disclosed a new ~$44m NEM stake; bullish miner commentary sits alongside third-party notes that the stock still looks rich on some scorecards.
On 18 Nov NEM fell roughly 5–8% with a broad gold sell-off (spot cited below $3,800), compressing margin versus Q3 realised prices per market coverage.
